title: Shopping cart
brief: Harbor & Pine sells clothing and accessories online, and we need the cart page shoppers see just before checkout. A simple white top bar holds our name in a serif and a 'Continue shopping' link. The page heading says how many items are in the cart. On the left, a list of the three items, each with a small drawn thumbnail, the product name, its variant, a remove link, a quantity stepper with minus and plus buttons, and the line price. On the right, a promo code box with an Apply button, and an order summary card with subtotal, shipping, tax and total, then a big Checkout button. The figures must add up. Keep it tidy and reassuring, with one strong royal blue for the main action.

requirements.text: A top bar with the brand 'Harbor & Pine' and a 'Continue shopping' link
Three line items, each with a thumbnail, name, variant, quantity control, price and a remove link
Items are Linen Overshirt (Size M, Sand, 1, $68.00), Merino Crew Socks (One size, Charcoal, 2, $24.00 at $12.00 each) and Canvas Tote Bag (Natural, 1, $32.00)
Each quantity stepper is a number field with a visible label and real minus and plus buttons
A promo code field with a visible label, placeholder and an Apply button
The order summary shows subtotal $124.00, shipping $6.00, tax (8%) $9.92 and total $139.92, and they add up
The total stands out from the other lines and a full-width Checkout button sits under it
Items on the left, promo and summary in a narrower column on the right
Text is easy to read against its background

designNotes: white cards on a very light grey page
one royal blue used for the checkout action
